drivingQuestion: Why doesn't the positive mitzva to burn leftover override the Yom Tov labor prohibition?
outcomeNote: The question is answered in the following unit (pesachim.sugya288)

segments.he: חָל שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר וְכוּ׳. וְאַמַּאי? נֵיתֵי עֲשֵׂה וְיִדְחֵי לֹא תַּעֲשֶׂה!
segments.en: It was taught in the mishna that if «the sixteenth» of Nisan «occurs» on Shabbat, the burning of the leftover does not override Shabbat, and they are burned on the seventeenth. The Gemara asks: «And why» isn’t the leftover of the Paschal lamb burned on the Festival day itself? «The positive mitzva» to burn the leftover «should come and override the prohibition» that prohibits the performance of labor on Festivals.

moves.summary: Why not let the positive mitzva override the prohibition?

edges.cueHe: ואמאי? ניתי עשה וידחי לא תעשה
edges.about: why the positive mitzva of burning leftover does not override the Yom Tov prohibition
